name: goal2_unit_comparison
description: Goal 2: does drawing five socks instead of four reduce embarrassment, and by how much? C and the seed set are held constant across both units so the unit is the only thing that varies. C=44 because a five-sock unit with n=4 requires C > 5*4+10 = 30, and 44 is the smallest multiple of 4 that clears it with headroom to spare. Both baselines are swept: greedy shows the effect on a strategy that actually uses the extra sock, random shows the effect with no strategy at all.
